reviewItem.question: Does "`Sidecar` scoping changes: During processing of services, Istio has a variety of conflict resolution strategies" mean a change to protocol-behavior:istio|name=sidecar-service-resolution (behavior-changed)?

change.before: "Conflict resolution strategy for service selection differed between environments with Sidecar resources and without; without Sidecar preferred Kubernetes Service, with Sidecar preferred Service in same namespace as proxy"
change.after: "Unified behavior: prefer Service in same namespace as proxy, then Kubernetes Service (not ServiceEntry), else arbitrary selection"

proposed.statement: Sidecar resource conflict resolution behavior when processing services is unified in version 1.24.0; service selection strategies now prefer the proxy's namespace and Kubernetes Services regardless of whether a Sidecar resource is defined.
